name: Forgemaster Veydran
role: Head of House Veydran, Golemcraft & Industry
title: The Forgemaster
bio: Head of House Veydran, master of the Veydran Foundries and Embersteel golem development. Oversees industrial production, golem engineering, and the Blackring Smiths guild. Proudly competitive with Thalos's Prismspire.
motivation: Prove that practical golemcraft and industrial innovation are the true backbone of Emberheart.
